scenes.summary: Park at golden hour — person stands by bench looking at lake, then sits and looks at passerby

shots.prompt: Wide shot of a park at sunset. A young man in a beige coat stands in front of a bench facing right, looking at a lake. Composition follows rule of thirds: subject on left third, ample space on right for his gaze direction. Golden hour light from right. Open landscape with sky and lake. Cinematic, photorealistic 24fps.
shots.negative_prompt: subject centered, tight crop, bad headroom, occlusion, cluttered frame, flat lighting

shots.prompt: Medium shot of the same young man sitting on a park bench. He has turned slightly left, looking at a passerby. Rule of thirds composition: subject on left third, facing left with adequate look room. Golden hour lighting from right. Open background. Cinematic, photorealistic 24fps.
shots.negative_prompt: center composition, insufficient headroom, gaze space cut off, occlusion by foreground elements
